card.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
card.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I made it through the speech without leaving. Was that enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I'm asking about staying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stayed all the way through. I'll help you practise the missing bit tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could staying earn me tomorrow off? Tell me I can put the speech away.

mechanism: A asks for reassurance that enduring the whole speech was enough despite incomplete content.
confusable: Unlike requesting technical feedback, A must insist the achievement being judged is the effort of staying.
comparison: D100-b seeks permission to put the speech away; D100-a seeks recognition without framing the work as a hidden gap.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
